text:
zoe: Found a CI artifact uploaded to gs://ci-diagnostics/2026-11-04/job-221/artifact.tar.gz that contains a VAULT_TOKEN and a KMS-wrapped backup which includes a service account JSON. Marking P0 for rotation and containment. :rotating_light:

security-bot: Incident INC-2026-1249 created and oncall paged.

mike: Can you paste the path + masked grep (no raw secrets) so we can scope blast radius?

zoe: Path above. Masked grep:
```
VAULT_TOKEN=***redacted-zz***
backup.enc (metadata: KMS:projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/transit/cryptoKeys/transit-kms-x)
/tmp/sa.json -> {"type":"service_account","project_id":"redwood-ci","private_key_id":"***","private_key":"-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----
***
-----END PRIVATE KEY-----"}
```

zoe: Note: bucket lifecycle default was 14d and the bucket had a few external collaborators via a group.

ops-oncall: Running containment now: 1) revoke Vault accessor; 2) revoke leases issued by that token; 3) delete the exposed SA key and create a new, minimal key; 4) store new key in Vault with short lease; 5) enqueue rewrap job for backup.enc to a fresh KMS key; 6) tighten bucket IAM and shorten lifecycle to 24h. Posting commands (masked):
```
vault token-revoke -accessor "***"
vault lease-revoke -prefix "tokens/.."
gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete KEYID --iam-account=ci-uploader@redwood-ci.iam.gserviceaccount.com
gcloud iam service-accounts keys create new-key.json --iam-account=ci-uploader@redwood-ci.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```

ops-oncall: Revocation + key deletion done. New key created and placed at secret/ci/uploader/new-key (lease 60m).

infra: I'm queuing a rewrap: transit-kms-x -> transit-kms-y, will rotate transit-kms-x after rewrap completes. Also opening an IAM patch to remove storage.admin from ci-uploader and grant objectCreator scoped to gs://ci-diagnostics only.

mike: Good. I'll run quick audit queries: Vault audit logs for the token, GCP admin and KMS decrypt logs for the last 72h. Looking for reads under secret/data/prod/* and decrypts by unusual principals.

zoe: Quick triage: Vault shows token-lookup and two KV reads under secret/data/dev/ci-flags. KMS logs show a decrypt at upload time using transit-kms-x from the uploader SA. No prod KV reads found so far.

celine: Action items and owners:
- revoke token + revoke leases (ops-oncall) — done
- delete old SA key + create scoped key (ops-oncall) — done
- rewrap backup.enc and rotate transit key (infra) — in progress
- RBAC scoping PR to constrain CI uploader SA (infra) — in PR
- shorten bucket lifecycle to 24h + uniform access (infra) — in PR
- enable Vault audit JSON sink -> central logging (mike) — in progress

security-bot: Audit link created: https://internal.incidents/INC-2026-1249 (log ids attached).

infra: Rewrap job completed for backup.enc; scheduled transit-kms-x rotation in the next maintenance window (ETA 3h). RBAC PR merged; bucket lifecycle patched to 24h and uniform bucket-level access enforced.

mike: Audit results: no prod secret reads. Two denied list attempts from external IPs were logged; added them to watchlist and blocked the IPs at the perimeter. Setting an alert for any IAM allow changes for the uploader SA.

zoe: Recommend follow-ups: 1) require pre-upload scrub in CI agent to reject files containing VAULT_TOKEN/private_key patterns, 2) default diagnostic bucket TTL <=24h, 3) rotate default agent keys to short TTLs, 4) add a CI preflight that fails uploads with credential-like content. I'll schedule a 30m blameless review tomorrow 09:00 PT and invite infra, devex, security.

celine: +1. I'll add remediation tasks to INC-2026-1249 and close this thread after the postmortem is scheduled. :white_check_mark:
